list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Refactor UI for localization and improve layout responsiveness
- **Localization & Internationalization**: - Externalized hardcoded strings across all screens, including Achievements, AI Assist, Decks, Journal, and Settings. - Updated `strings.xml` with new keys and placeholders for dynamic content. - Provided comprehensive Afrikaans (`values-af`) and isiZulu (`values-zu`) translations for the entire application. - **UI/UX Refinement**: - **Achievements**: Refactored `AchievementScreen` to use `LazyColumn` instead of a grid for the primary layout, improving scroll performance and layout flexibility. - **Main Dashboard**: Wrapped the main activity layout in a `ScrollView` to prevent clipping on smaller screens. - **Auth Screens**: Enhanced `LoginScreen` and `RegisterScreen` with improved typography, bold labels, and consistent field styling; removed the placeholder "Forgot Password" link. - **Journal**: Added localized mood names and improved the "New Entry" screen with better text styling and dynamic date formatting. - **Settings**: Simplified the settings menu by removing the unused Security section and externalizing status labels (e.g., "Dark", "Warm", "On/Off"). - **Feature Enhancements**: - **Progress Tracking**: Implemented logic in `IVU.kt` to reset daily review progress in the UI when a new day is detected based on `lastActiveDate`. - **AI Assist**: Added localized suggestion chips and typing indicators. - **Technical Improvements**: - Added debug logging to `ViewModelFactory` to track ViewModel instantiation. - Standardized string formatting for streaks and level labels using `%1$d` placeholders.

task.summary: Default task

Setup Room database and implement core expense tracking architecture
- Configure Room, KSP, and Navigation dependencies in `build.gradle.kts`. - Define data entities for User, Category, Expense, Goal, Achievement, and CurrencyRate. - Implement DAOs and a central `AppDatabase` with a singleton `DatabaseProvider`. - Add repository classes and ViewModels for Achievements, Expenses, and Authentication. - Create placeholder Compose screens for Dashboard, Expenses, Goals, Achievements, and Login. - Update `MainActivity` to initialize the database, seed initial achievements, and handle test data.

Setup Room database and implement core expense tracking architecture
- Configure Room, KSP, and Navigation dependencies in `build.gradle.kts`. - Define data entities for User, Category, Expense, Goal, Achievement, and CurrencyRate. - Implement DAOs and a central `AppDatabase` with a singleton `DatabaseProvider`. - Add repository classes and ViewModels for Achievements, Expenses, and Authentication. - Create placeholder Compose screens for Dashboard, Expenses, Goals, Achievements, and Login. - Update `MainActivity` to initialize the database, seed initial achievements, and handle test data.

Refine data layer and enhance achievement logic
- Implement `CurrencyRepository` and `GoalRepository` to abstract DAO operations. - Update `Expense` entity with a foreign key relationship to `Category` and add supporting indices. - Simplify achievement initialization in `MainActivity` using a list-based insertion approach. - Refactor `AchievementRepository` and `MainActivity` to unify achievement unlocking logic. - Clean up unused imports and redundant whitespace across DAO, Entity, and Database classes. - Add documentation comments to repository classes for better code clarity.

Implement authentication, splash screen, and real-time dashboard updates
- **Authentication & User Management**: Added a `password` field to the `User` entity, implemented login logic in `MainActivity`, and created a functional `RegisterActivity`. - **Navigation & Lifecycle**: Introduced `SplashActivity` as the new entry point with a 2-second delay. Updated `AndroidManifest.xml` to reflect activity name changes and launcher configurations. - **Data Layer**: - Updated `ExpenseDao` to return `Flow` for total spending, category summaries, and expense counts to support real-time UI updates. - Incremented `AppDatabase` version to `2` and enabled `fallbackToDestructiveMigration`. - Added `getUserByName` to `UserDao` and updated `ExpenseRepository` and `ExpenseViewModel` to expose new spending and summary flows. - **UI & UX**: - Redesigned `activity_dashboard.xml` using `ConstraintLayout` and `CardView` for a modern look. - Updated `AddExpenseActivity` (formerly `AddExpensesActivityActivity`) to persist actual expense data to the database. - Refined `bg_card` drawable and updated the app theme to use `AppCompat.DayNight`. - Replaced default launcher icons with a custom logo. - **Cleanup**: Removed Compose-based test logic from `MainActivity` in favor of XML-based Activity logic.

Implement authentication, splash screen, and real-time dashboard updates
- **Authentication & User Management**: Added a `password` field to the `User` entity, implemented login logic in `MainActivity`, and created a functional `RegisterActivity`. - **Navigation & Lifecycle**: Introduced `SplashActivity` as the new entry point with a 2-second delay. Updated `AndroidManifest.xml` to reflect activity name changes and launcher configurations. - **Data Layer**: - Updated `ExpenseDao` to return `Flow` for total spending, category summaries, and expense counts to support real-time UI updates. - Incremented `AppDatabase` version to `2` and enabled `fallbackToDestructiveMigration`. - Added `getUserByName` to `UserDao` and updated `ExpenseRepository` and `ExpenseViewModel` to expose new spending and summary flows. - **UI & UX**: - Redesigned `activity_dashboard.xml` using `ConstraintLayout` and `CardView` for a modern look. - Updated `AddExpenseActivity` (formerly `AddExpensesActivityActivity`) to persist actual expense data to the database. - Refined `bg_card` drawable and updated the app theme to use `AppCompat.DayNight`. - Replaced default launcher icons with a custom logo. - **Cleanup**: Removed Compose-based test logic from `MainActivity` in favor of XML-based Activity logic.

Revitalize UI/UX and enhance data layer with real-time updates
- Implement a modern, reusable bottom navigation bar across all main activities. - Refactor `Dashboard` to use `ExpenseViewModel` and support real-time data updates via Flows. - Integrate Jetpack Compose into XML layouts to render dynamic charts for spending breakdowns and goals. - Redesign `Dashboard`, `AddExpense`, `Goals`, and `Reports` layouts with improved styling, card-based UI, and rounded headers. - Enhance `SplashActivity` with fade-in/slide-up animations and a Coroutine-based transition. - Update `ExpenseDao` and `ExpenseRepository` to support fetching recent transactions and improve naming consistency. - Implement a `RoomDatabase.Callback` in `DatabaseProvider` to pre-populate default categories on database creation. - Add specific color resources and custom drawables for a unified design language.

Enhance data persistence and expand core features for goals, expenses, and reporting
- **Data Layer Improvements**: - Update `AppDatabase` to version 3 and implement thread-safe singleton initialization with `@Volatile` and `synchronized`. - Refactor `Goal` entity to include `name`, `targetAmount`, and `currentAmount` fields. - Expand `GoalDao` and `GoalRepository` with methods for deletion, updates, and Flow-based queries (all goals and top goals). - Update `CategoryDao` to include a one-shot fetch for categories and use `IGNORE` conflict strategy. - Improve database pre-population logic to check for existing categories on database open.
- **Expense Management**: - Enhance `AddExpenseActivity` with `DatePickerDialog` and `TimePickerDialog` for precise entry. - Add photo attachment support to expenses using `ActivityResultContracts.GetContent`. - Update expense saving logic to capture date, time, and photo URI.
- **Dashboard & Reporting**: - Integrate real goal data into the Dashboard's Compose-based charts with progress tracking. - Implement real-time data observation in `ReportsActivity`, displaying total, average, highest, and lowest spending. - Add category and time period filters (Spinners) to the Reports screen. - Refactor `LineChart` styling to match the application's green theme.
- **UI/UX Refinement**: - Redesign `SetGoalsActivity` layout to focus on creating specific savings goals rather than general budget limits. - Update various layout files (`add_expenses_activity.xml`, `goals.xml`, `reports.xml`) for improved spacing, better labeling, and consistent color themes. - Remove redundant "Vision" text from the splash screen.

Revamp UI/UX and enhance core feature set
- **UI/UX Overhaul**: - Introduced a consistent `common_header` layout and a unified `nav_bar` component across all screens. - Updated `activity_main` and `activity_register` with a clean, card-based design and improved typography. - Redesigned the Dashboard with an extended green header, modern card elevations, and a revamped XP progress bar. - Standardized input fields and buttons using new `rounded_edittext` and `rounded_button` drawables.
- **Feature Enhancements**: - Added a "Custom Category" option in `AddExpenseActivity` to allow user-defined spending categories. - Enhanced Goal tracking in `Dashboard` with an interactive "Edit Amount" feature via a Compose-based dialog. - Expanded the `Goal` entity and UI to support `minTargetAmount` and `maxTargetAmount`. - Implemented PDF report exportation in `ReportsActivity`. - Improved data visualization in Reports with dynamic line charts and category/time-period filtering.
- **Technical Updates**: - Incremented `AppDatabase` version to 4 to accommodate schema changes in the `Goal` entity. - Refactored navigation logic across `Dashboard`, `AddExpenseActivity`, `GoalsActivity`, and `ReportsActivity` for better consistency. - Updated `Expense` entity with a default null value for `photoPath`.

Update SplashActivity animations and transition logic
- Replace `androidx.appcompat` slide animation with standard `android.R.anim.slide_in_left`. - Explicitly set `pbLoading` visibility to `VISIBLE` during the splash delay. - Add `overridePendingTransition` with a deprecation suppression for the activity transition. - Clean up XML header in `.idea/misc.xml`.

Implement multi-user support, budget tracking, and gamified achievements
- **Data Layer Enhancements**: - Update `User`, `Expense`, `Category`, `Goal`, and `Achievement` entities to include `userId` for multi-user data isolation. - Implement foreign key relationships and indices across entities to ensure data integrity. - Expand `ExpenseDao` and `GoalDao` with queries for category summaries, date-range filtering, and budget-specific tracking. - Increment database version to 6.
- **New Features & Gamification**: - Implement an `AchievementRepository` with logic to unlock rewards for milestones like first expenses, daily streaks, and staying under budget. - Add a `ChatViewModel` and `ChatBottomSheetFragment` to provide a "Pocket Eye Assistant" chatbot for financial tips and balance queries. - Integrate a currency converter with real-time conversion logic in `CurrencyViewModel`. - Support receipt photo attachments for expenses, including a full-screen photo viewer dialog.
- **UI & UX Improvements**: - Refactor `Dashboard` with Jetpack Compose charts for "Savings Goals" progress and "Spending Breakdown." - Implement a new "Budget Tracker" component to visualize spending against category-specific limits. - Redesign the main navigation with a `BottomAppBar` and a radial floating action button (FAB) menu for quick actions. - Add `ManageCategoriesActivity` to allow users to customize their expense categories. - Update `SplashActivity` to handle persistent user sessions via `SharedPreferences`.
- **Technical Updates**: - Integrate `MPAndroidChart` for reporting and visualization. - Apply consistent Material Design 3 styling and color schemes across all activities and layouts. - Add `windowSoftInputMode` configurations to `AndroidManifest.xml` for better keyboard handling in forms.

Implement PDF export preview and refine UI layouts
- Add `FileProvider` configuration to `AndroidManifest.xml` and define file paths for secure PDF sharing. - Enhance PDF export in `ReportsActivity` with a success dialog and an option to open the file using a `FileProvider` URI. - Update `goals.xml` to use `NestedScrollView` for better scroll performance and add text labels to the radial FAB menu. - Refactor `ReportsActivity` to clean up redundant comments and ensure consistent category coloring across charts and lists. - Improve receipt thumbnail handling in the expenses adapter with better fallback logic.

Implement unit testing suite and refine reports logic
- Add test dependencies for MockK, Coroutines, Turbine, and AndroidX Arch Core. - Implement comprehensive unit tests for `AuthViewModel`, `AchievementViewModel`, `ExpenseViewModel`, `ChatViewModel`, and `CurrencyViewModel`. - Add unit tests for `AchievementRepository` to verify achievement unlocking logic. - Update `ReportsActivity` to improve image URI handling and fix photo dialog layout issues. - Refine date filtering and average spending calculations in `ReportsActivity`. - Update expense list UI in reports to include consistent tinting for placeholder receipt icons.

Implement achievement system and CI/CD workflow
- Implement `AchievementsActivity` and `AchievementAdapter` to display user milestones. - Create `activity_achievements.xml` and `item_achievement.xml` layouts with lock/unlock states. - Add GitHub Actions workflow in `.github/workflows/build.yml` for automated builds and unit testing. - Integrate achievement navigation into the `Dashboard` via the XP card and update the radial FAB menu logic. - Refactor `SetGoalsActivity` to improve category loading, edit mode handling, and navigation consistency. - Update `README.md` with comprehensive project details, including feature descriptions, tech stack, and CI/CD status. - Add `nav_achievements` and other supporting string resources to `strings.xml`. - Register `AchievementsActivity` in the `AndroidManifest.xml`.

Enhance achievement system and implement leveling celebrations
- Update `Achievement` entity to include `isNotified` field and increment database version to 7. - Refactor `AchievementRepository` to return newly unlocked achievements and improve budget tracking logic. - Expand `AchievementDao` with queries to handle unnotified achievements and fetch records once. - Update `ExpenseViewModel` to track levels (now every 5 expenses) and emit `ExpenseEvent` for level-ups and new achievements. - Implement celebration dialogs in `Dashboard` to notify users of level-ups and earned badges. - Enhance `AchievementsActivity` with automatic seeding of initial achievements and mapping achievement icons to visual assets. - Adjust `ChatViewModel` logic to align with the updated XP and leveling thresholds.

Update README documentation with detailed project information
- Add project description, feature highlights, and technical overview. - Elaborate on the AI Chat Assistant, Multi-Currency Converter, and Gamified Experience (XP and Leveling system). - Expand technical details regarding MVVM architecture, hybrid Jetpack Compose/XML UI, and Room database usage. - Update installation instructions and list key project dependencies. - Improve accessibility by adding alt text to placeholder images.

Enhance codebase with comprehensive logging, documentation, and architectural refinements
- **Logging & Observability**: Integrated extensive `Log` statements across all Activities, ViewModels, and Repositories to track lifecycle events, database operations, user authentication, and navigation flows. - **Documentation**: Added class-level KDoc comments and function-level documentation to core components like `Dashboard`, `ReportsActivity`, and `ExpenseRepository` explaining their purpose and logic. - **Architectural Refinements**: - Centralized data access in `ExpenseRepository` and `AchievementRepository` with reactive `Flow` logging. - Updated `ExpenseViewModel` to handle gamification events (Level Up, Achievement Unlocked) via `SharedFlow`. - Refined `Dashboard` UI logic to dynamically hide navigation bars when the keyboard is active to maximize screen space. - **Bug Fixes & Stability**: - Added safety checks for user session validation across all major activities. - Improved bitmap handling in `ReportsActivity` with downsampling and persistable URI permission handling for receipt photos. - Fixed potential null pointer issues in `CurrencyViewModel` by improving input parsing. - **Documentation Update**: Overhauled `README.md` to include detailed sections on purpose, technical design decisions, MVVM architecture, and CI/CD integration. - **Redundancy**: Created a duplicate `ExpenseRepository.kt` in a top-level directory (likely for organizational cleanup).

Deprecate legacy Expense Tracker components and externalize strings in `activity_main.xml`
- **Deprecation**: Marked several core activities and UI components as deprecated, including `AddExpenseActivity`, `SplashActivity`, `RegisterActivity`, `ManageCategoriesActivity`, `AchievementsActivity`, `GoalsActivity`, `ReportsActivity`, and the `Chat` UI components, in favor of the new `IVU` architecture. - **Localization & Clean-up**: - Refactored `activity_main.xml` to use string resources instead of hardcoded text for labels, hints, and content descriptions. - Added `autofillHints` to email and password fields for better user experience. - Updated `strings.xml` with new keys for the authentication screens. - **Refactoring**: Redirected legacy `Dashboard.kt` to the updated `IVU.kt` component.

Implement network synchronization and refactor application architecture to MVVM
- **Networking**: Integrated Retrofit and OkHttp for API communication, including an `AuthInterceptor` to attach Firebase ID tokens to requests. - **MVVM Architecture**: - Introduced `Repository` and `ViewModel` layers for `Deck`, `Flashcard`, and `Journal` components to manage data flow between local Room database and remote API. - Implemented `ViewModelFactory` to handle dependency injection for the new ViewModels. - **Data Persistence**: - Updated `Deck`, `Flashcard`, and `JournalEntry` entities to include `remoteId` for backend synchronization. - Incremented database version to 9. - **Feature Enhancements**: - **Decks & Journal**: Added background refresh logic to sync local data with the server on activity start. - **Flashcards**: Refactored `ReviewActivity` to submit card ratings to the backend and updated `AddEditCardActivity` with remote create/delete capabilities. - **UI/UX**: Added a delete action to the card editor and externalized several UI strings for better localization. - **Configuration**: - Added `INTERNET` permission to `AndroidManifest.xml`. - Updated `build.gradle.kts` with dependencies for Retrofit, OkHttp, Coil, and Firebase Auth.

Integrate Firebase Authentication and Google Sign-In
- **Authentication**: - Implemented Google Sign-In using the `androidx.credentials` API and `CredentialManager` in `MainActivity` and `RegisterActivity`. - Integrated Firebase Authentication to handle Google ID tokens and manage user sessions. - **Local Synchronization**: - Added logic to sync Firebase-authenticated users with the local Room database. - Implemented automatic local user profile creation and achievement initialization for first-time Google sign-ins. - **Configuration**: - Added `google-services.json` for Firebase project configuration. - Applied the Google Services plugin to `app/build.gradle.kts`. - Externalized the Google Web Client ID to `strings.xml` and a new `Constants` object. - **Dependencies**: - Added Firebase BoM, Auth, and Analytics dependencies. - Included `androidx.credentials` and `googleid` libraries. - Updated Kotlin to version 2.1.10 and KSP to 2.1.10-1.0.30. - **Cleanup**: Removed unused `appcompat` dependency and cleaned up manual context references in `MainActivity` and `RegisterActivity`.

Refactor UI resources for localization and upgrade build configuration to JDK 17
- **Localization & String Management**: - Externalized hardcoded strings across all layout files (`achievements`, `decks`, `journal`, `settings`, etc.) to `strings.xml`. - Introduced `plurals` for achievements, due cards, and day formats to handle grammatical variations. - Marked non-translatable strings (formatting, IDs) with `translatable="false"`. - **UI & Accessibility**: - Added `contentDescription` to image-based views across the application for improved accessibility. - Enhanced input fields in `RegisterActivity` and `AddEditCardActivity` with appropriate `inputType`, `autofillHints`, and `importantForAutofill` attributes. - Simplified `item_badge.xml` by using `drawableTop` instead of nested views. - Added a missing back button to the Journal screen. - **Build System & Dependencies**: - Upgraded `sourceCompatibility`, `targetCompatibility`, and `jvmToolchain` from version 11 to 17. - Migrated remaining direct dependency strings in `build.gradle.kts` to Version Catalog (`libs.versions.toml`). - Updated Gradle Wrapper to version 9.5.0 and refined bytecode target levels in project configuration. - **Performance & Logic**: - Refactored `ChatAdapter` to use `DiffUtil` for efficient RecyclerView updates instead of `notifyDataSetChanged()`. - Updated Google Sign-In logic in `MainActivity` and `RegisterActivity` to support `TYPE_GOOGLE_ID_TOKEN_SIWG_CREDENTIAL`. - **Cleanup**: - Removed redundant background color definitions from layout roots to rely on theme-level styling. - Updated `CalendarDayLabel` style for better padding distribution.

Implement plural string resources for UI components
- **UI Localization**: - Updated `AchievementScreen` to use `pluralStringResource` for displaying the current streak, ensuring proper grammatical formatting for day counts. - Updated `DecksScreen` to use `pluralStringResource` for the card count display in deck items. - **IDE Configuration**: Updated internal planning mode state in `.idea/planningMode.xml`.

Refactor gamification system and finalize application UI/UX for IVU study hub
- **Achievements & Gamification**: - Replaced the legacy achievement system with a new `Badge` framework and `UserStats` model to track XP, levels, and streaks. - Implemented sophisticated streak logic (current and longest) and daily activity tracking. - Redesigned `AchievementScreen` with a progress dashboard, weekly activity bar chart, and an interactive badge grid with unlock feedback. - Added a badge unlock notification dialog to the Flashcard and Journal workflows. - **Authentication & Session Management**: - Transitioned all repositories, DAOs, and entities to use Firebase UIDs (`String`) instead of local `Long` IDs for user identification. - Polished `LoginScreen` and `RegisterScreen` with consistent branding, improved form validation UI, and Google Sign-In styling. - Updated `MainActivity` to manage session persistence using `firebase_uid`. - **Feature Enhancements**: - **Flashcards**: Integrated review sessions with the achievement system and added a session progress indicator to `FlashcardReviewScreen`. - **Journal**: Replaced the new entry dialog with a dedicated `NewJournalEntryScreen` featuring mood selection and deck linking. - **AI Assistant**: Overhauled the `AiAssistScreen` UI with colored message bubbles, typing indicators, and suggestion chips. - **Architecture & Data Persistence**: - Incremented database version to 12 and added `TypeConverters` for `List<String>` to support badge storage. - Removed all deprecated `expensetracker` legacy components, including DAOs, entities, and ViewModels. - Consolidated `ViewModelFactory` to handle the new `String`-based user identifiers. - **UI/UX & Branding**: - Established `IVUTheme` and applied it across all Compose screens for visual consistency. - Refactored XML layouts (`activity_ivu.xml`, `layout_bottom_nav.xml`) to use theme-aware color attributes. - Updated the splash screen logic to initialize demo data and user stats for new Firebase users. - **Configuration & CI**: - Updated GitHub Actions workflow to use latest `actions/checkout@v4` and `setup-java@v4`. - Set `AchievementsActivity` to `exported="true"` in `AndroidManifest.xml`.

Implement unified UI components, dark theme support, and enhanced deck management
- **Navigation & UI Architecture**: - Replaced legacy XML bottom navigation with a shared Compose `BottomNavigationBar` across `IVU`, `DecksActivity`, `JournalActivity`, `AchievementsActivity`, and `SettingsActivity`. - Integrated `Scaffold` into several screens to manage layout, bars, and floating action buttons consistently. - Updated `IVUTheme` to include specific light/dark surface and text color definitions. - **Theme & Language Management**: - Integrated `PreferenceManager` across all activities to observe and apply dark theme and app language settings dynamically. - Added a language selection dialog and a study reminders toggle in the `SettingsScreen`. - Implemented `AppCompatDelegate` observers in the main activity to handle configuration changes for theme and locale. - **Feature Enhancements**: - **Decks**: Added the ability to delete decks from both the `DecksScreen` and `FlashcardListScreen` via a confirmation dialog and dropdown menu. - **Journal**: - Implemented deck-linking for journal entries, allowing users to associate specific study decks with their entries via a new `FilterChip` UI. - Refactored `JournalViewModel` to fetch both journal and deck data. - Improved date parsing and formatting for journal entry display. - **Achievements**: Refactored the `AchievementScreen` to use Material 3 components and standardized XP progress calculation. - **Data & Configuration**: - Transitioned `FlashcardRepository` and `JournalRepository` to use `firebase_uid` instead of local IDs for user identification. - Updated `ViewModelFactory` with a cleaner `when` structure to handle multi-repository dependency injection. - Updated `strings.xml` and localized variants (Afrikaans, isiZulu) with new navigation labels, goal formats, and plural definitions. - Added a `study_reminders` key to `PreferenceManager`.

Enhance data persistence and expand core features for goals, expenses, and reporting

- **Expense Management**: - Enhance `AddExpenseActivity` with `DatePickerDialog` and `TimePickerDialog` for precise entry. - Add photo attachment support to expenses using `ActivityResultContracts.GetContent`. - Update expense saving logic to capture date, time, and photo URI.
- **Dashboard & Reporting**: - Integrate real goal data into the Dashboard's Compose-based charts with progress tracking. - Implement real-time data observation in `ReportsActivity`, displaying total, average, highest, and lowest spending. - Add category and time period filters (Spinners) to the Reports screen. - Refactor `LineChart` styling to match the application's green theme.
- **UI/UX Refinement**: - Redesign `SetGoalsActivity` layout to focus on creating specific savings goals rather than general budget limits. - Update various layout files (`add_expenses_activity.xml`, `goals.xml`, `reports.xml`) for improved spacing, better labeling, and consistent color themes. - Remove redundant "Vision" text from the splash screen.

Revamp UI/UX and enhance core feature set
- **UI/UX Overhaul**: - Introduced a consistent `common_header` layout and a unified `nav_bar` component across all screens. - Updated `activity_main` and `activity_register` with a clean, card-based design and improved typography. - Redesigned the Dashboard with an extended green header, modern card elevations, and a revamped XP progress bar. - Standardized input fields and buttons using new `rounded_edittext` and `rounded_button` drawables.

- **Technical Updates**: - Incremented `AppDatabase` version to 4 to accommodate schema changes in the `Goal` entity. - Refactored navigation logic across `Dashboard`, `AddExpenseActivity`, `GoalsActivity`, and `ReportsActivity` for better consistency. - Updated `Expense` entity with a default null value for `photoPath`.

Update SplashActivity animations and transition logic

Implement multi-user support, budget tracking, and gamified achievements
- **Data Layer Enhancements**: - Update `User`, `Expense`, `Category`, `Goal`, and `Achievement` entities to include `userId` for multi-user data isolation. - Implement foreign key relationships and indices across entities to ensure data integrity. - Expand `ExpenseDao` and `GoalDao` with queries for category summaries, date-range filtering, and budget-specific tracking. - Increment database version to 6.
- **New Features & Gamification**: - Implement an `AchievementRepository` with logic to unlock rewards for milestones like first expenses, daily streaks, and staying under budget. - Add a `ChatViewModel` and `ChatBottomSheetFragment` to provide a "Pocket Eye Assistant" chatbot for financial tips and balance queries. - Integrate a currency converter with real-time conversion logic in `CurrencyViewModel`. - Support receipt photo attachments for expenses, including a full-screen photo viewer dialog.
- **UI & UX Improvements**: - Refactor `Dashboard` with Jetpack Compose charts for "Savings Goals" progress and "Spending Breakdown." - Implement a new "Budget Tracker" component to visualize spending against category-specific limits. - Redesign the main navigation with a `BottomAppBar` and a radial floating action button (FAB) menu for quick actions. - Add `ManageCategoriesActivity` to allow users to customize their expense categories. - Update `SplashActivity` to handle persistent user sessions via `SharedPreferences`.
- **Technical Updates**: - Integrate `MPAndroidChart` for reporting and visualization. - Apply consistent Material Design 3 styling and color schemes across all activities and layouts. - Add `windowSoftInputMode` configurations to `AndroidManifest.xml` for better keyboard handling in forms.

Implement PDF export preview and refine UI layouts
- Add `FileProvider` configuration to `AndroidManifest.xml` and define file paths for secure PDF sharing. - Enhance PDF export in `ReportsActivity` with a success dialog and an option to open the file using a `FileProvider` URI. - Update `goals.xml` to use `NestedScrollView` for better scroll performance and add text labels to the radial FAB menu. - Refactor `ReportsActivity` to clean up redundant comments and ensure consistent category coloring across charts and lists. - Improve receipt thumbnail handling in the expenses adapter with better fallback logic.

Implement unit testing suite and refine reports logic
- Add test dependencies for MockK, Coroutines, Turbine, and AndroidX Arch Core. - Implement comprehensive unit tests for `AuthViewModel`, `AchievementViewModel`, `ExpenseViewModel`, `ChatViewModel`, and `CurrencyViewModel`. - Add unit tests for `AchievementRepository` to verify achievement unlocking logic. - Update `ReportsActivity` to improve image URI handling and fix photo dialog layout issues. - Refine date filtering and average spending calculations in `ReportsActivity`. - Update expense list UI in reports to include consistent tinting for placeholder receipt icons.

Implement gamification achievements and enhance UI/UX across the core application architecture.
- **Achievements System**: Introduce `AchievementsActivity` with a RecyclerView and `AchievementAdapter` to display unlocked and locked badges. - **Data & Logic**: Implement `AchievementViewModel` and integrate with `AchievementRepository` to track user progress and unlock status. - **UI Enhancements**: - Add `item_achievement.xml` and `activity_achievements.xml` layouts with custom animations. - Update `Dashboard` with an interactive XP card to navigate to Achievements. - Refactor `GoalsActivity` navigation and simplify layout logic. - **Infrastructure**: - Configure **GitHub Actions** CI/CD pipeline in `.github/workflows/build.yml` for automated builds and unit testing. - Update `README.md` with comprehensive project details, including CI/CD status, tech stack, and custom AI features. - **Resource Updates**: Add new string resources for achievements and goals; register `AchievementsActivity` in the manifest. - **Code Quality**: Clean up unused imports and redundant comments in `Dashboard.kt` and `GoalsActivity.kt`.

Implement achievement system and CI/CD workflow
- Implement `AchievementsActivity` and `AchievementAdapter` to display user milestones. - Create `activity_achievements.xml` and `item_achievement.xml` layouts with lock/unlock states. - Add GitHub Actions workflow in `.github/workflows/build.yml` for automated builds and unit testing. - Integrate achievement navigation into the `Dashboard` via the XP card and update the radial FAB menu logic. - Refactor `SetGoalsActivity` to improve category loading, edit mode handling, and navigation consistency. - Update `README.md` with comprehensive project details, including feature descriptions, tech stack, and CI/CD status. - Add `nav_achievements` and other supporting string resources to `strings.xml`. - Register `AchievementsActivity` in the `AndroidManifest.xml`.

Enhance achievement system and implement leveling celebrations
- Update `Achievement` entity to include `isNotified` field and increment database version to 7. - Refactor `AchievementRepository` to return newly unlocked achievements and improve budget tracking logic. - Expand `AchievementDao` with queries to handle unnotified achievements and fetch records once. - Update `ExpenseViewModel` to track levels (now every 5 expenses) and emit `ExpenseEvent` for level-ups and new achievements. - Implement celebration dialogs in `Dashboard` to notify users of level-ups and earned badges. - Enhance `AchievementsActivity` with automatic seeding of initial achievements and mapping achievement icons to visual assets. - Adjust `ChatViewModel` logic to align with the updated XP and leveling thresholds.

Update README documentation with detailed project information
- Add project description, feature highlights, and technical overview. - Elaborate on the AI Chat Assistant, Multi-Currency Converter, and Gamified Experience (XP and Leveling system). - Expand technical details regarding MVVM architecture, hybrid Jetpack Compose/XML UI, and Room database usage. - Update installation instructions and list key project dependencies. - Improve accessibility by adding alt text to placeholder images.

Enhance codebase with comprehensive logging, documentation, and architectural refinements
- **Logging & Observability**: Integrated extensive `Log` statements across all Activities, ViewModels, and Repositories to track lifecycle events, database operations, user authentication, and navigation flows. - **Documentation**: Added class-level KDoc comments and function-level documentation to core components like `Dashboard`, `ReportsActivity`, and `ExpenseRepository` explaining their purpose and logic. - **Architectural Refinements**: - Centralized data access in `ExpenseRepository` and `AchievementRepository` with reactive `Flow` logging. - Updated `ExpenseViewModel` to handle gamification events (Level Up, Achievement Unlocked) via `SharedFlow`. - Refined `Dashboard` UI logic to dynamically hide navigation bars when the keyboard is active to maximize screen space. - **Bug Fixes & Stability**: - Added safety checks for user session validation across all major activities. - Improved bitmap handling in `ReportsActivity` with downsampling and persistable URI permission handling for receipt photos. - Fixed potential null pointer issues in `CurrencyViewModel` by improving input parsing. - **Documentation Update**: Overhauled `README.md` to include detailed sections on purpose, technical design decisions, MVVM architecture, and CI/CD integration. - **Redundancy**: Created a duplicate `ExpenseRepository.kt` in a top-level directory (likely for organizational cleanup).

Deprecate legacy Expense Tracker components and externalize strings in `activity_main.xml`
- **Deprecation**: Marked several core activities and UI components as deprecated, including `AddExpenseActivity`, `SplashActivity`, `RegisterActivity`, `ManageCategoriesActivity`, `AchievementsActivity`, `GoalsActivity`, `ReportsActivity`, and the `Chat` UI components, in favor of the new `IVU` architecture. - **Localization & Clean-up**: - Refactored `activity_main.xml` to use string resources instead of hardcoded text for labels, hints, and content descriptions. - Added `autofillHints` to email and password fields for better user experience. - Updated `strings.xml` with new keys for the authentication screens. - **Refactoring**: Redirected legacy `Dashboard.kt` to the updated `IVU.kt` component.

Implement network synchronization and refactor application architecture to MVVM
- **Networking**: Integrated Retrofit and OkHttp for API communication, including an `AuthInterceptor` to attach Firebase ID tokens to requests. - **MVVM Architecture**: - Introduced `Repository` and `ViewModel` layers for `Deck`, `Flashcard`, and `Journal` components to manage data flow between local Room database and remote API. - Implemented `ViewModelFactory` to handle dependency injection for the new ViewModels. - **Data Persistence**: - Updated `Deck`, `Flashcard`, and `JournalEntry` entities to include `remoteId` for backend synchronization. - Incremented database version to 9. - **Feature Enhancements**: - **Decks & Journal**: Added background refresh logic to sync local data with the server on activity start. - **Flashcards**: Refactored `ReviewActivity` to submit card ratings to the backend and updated `AddEditCardActivity` with remote create/delete capabilities. - **UI/UX**: Added a delete action to the card editor and externalized several UI strings for better localization. - **Configuration**: - Added `INTERNET` permission to `AndroidManifest.xml`. - Updated `build.gradle.kts` with dependencies for Retrofit, OkHttp, Coil, and Firebase Auth.

Integrate Firebase Authentication and Google Sign-In
- **Authentication**: - Implemented Google Sign-In using the `androidx.credentials` API and `CredentialManager` in `MainActivity` and `RegisterActivity`. - Integrated Firebase Authentication to handle Google ID tokens and manage user sessions. - **Local Synchronization**: - Added logic to sync Firebase-authenticated users with the local Room database. - Implemented automatic local user profile creation and achievement initialization for first-time Google sign-ins. - **Configuration**: - Added `google-services.json` for Firebase project configuration. - Applied the Google Services plugin to `app/build.gradle.kts`. - Externalized the Google Web Client ID to `strings.xml` and a new `Constants` object. - **Dependencies**: - Added Firebase BoM, Auth, and Analytics dependencies. - Included `androidx.credentials` and `googleid` libraries. - Updated Kotlin to version 2.1.10 and KSP to 2.1.10-1.0.30. - **Cleanup**: Removed unused `appcompat` dependency and cleaned up manual context references in `MainActivity` and `RegisterActivity`.

Refactor UI resources for localization and upgrade build configuration to JDK 17
- **Localization & String Management**: - Externalized hardcoded strings across all layout files (`achievements`, `decks`, `journal`, `settings`, etc.) to `strings.xml`. - Introduced `plurals` for achievements, due cards, and day formats to handle grammatical variations. - Marked non-translatable strings (formatting, IDs) with `translatable="false"`. - **UI & Accessibility**: - Added `contentDescription` to image-based views across the application for improved accessibility. - Enhanced input fields in `RegisterActivity` and `AddEditCardActivity` with appropriate `inputType`, `autofillHints`, and `importantForAutofill` attributes. - Simplified `item_badge.xml` by using `drawableTop` instead of nested views. - Added a missing back button to the Journal screen. - **Build System & Dependencies**: - Upgraded `sourceCompatibility`, `targetCompatibility`, and `jvmToolchain` from version 11 to 17. - Migrated remaining direct dependency strings in `build.gradle.kts` to Version Catalog (`libs.versions.toml`). - Updated Gradle Wrapper to version 9.5.0 and refined bytecode target levels in project configuration. - **Performance & Logic**: - Refactored `ChatAdapter` to use `DiffUtil` for efficient RecyclerView updates instead of `notifyDataSetChanged()`. - Updated Google Sign-In logic in `MainActivity` and `RegisterActivity` to support `TYPE_GOOGLE_ID_TOKEN_SIWG_CREDENTIAL`. - **Cleanup**: - Removed redundant background color definitions from layout roots to rely on theme-level styling. - Updated `CalendarDayLabel` style for better padding distribution.

Implement plural string resources for UI components
- **UI Localization**: - Updated `AchievementScreen` to use `pluralStringResource` for displaying the current streak, ensuring proper grammatical formatting for day counts. - Updated `DecksScreen` to use `pluralStringResource` for the card count display in deck items. - **IDE Configuration**: Updated internal planning mode state in `.idea/planningMode.xml`.

Refactor gamification system and finalize application UI/UX for IVU study hub
- **Achievements & Gamification**: - Replaced the legacy achievement system with a new `Badge` framework and `UserStats` model to track XP, levels, and streaks. - Implemented sophisticated streak logic (current and longest) and daily activity tracking. - Redesigned `AchievementScreen` with a progress dashboard, weekly activity bar chart, and an interactive badge grid with unlock feedback. - Added a badge unlock notification dialog to the Flashcard and Journal workflows. - **Authentication & Session Management**: - Transitioned all repositories, DAOs, and entities to use Firebase UIDs (`String`) instead of local `Long` IDs for user identification. - Polished `LoginScreen` and `RegisterScreen` with consistent branding, improved form validation UI, and Google Sign-In styling. - Updated `MainActivity` to manage session persistence using `firebase_uid`. - **Feature Enhancements**: - **Flashcards**: Integrated review sessions with the achievement system and added a session progress indicator to `FlashcardReviewScreen`. - **Journal**: Replaced the new entry dialog with a dedicated `NewJournalEntryScreen` featuring mood selection and deck linking. - **AI Assistant**: Overhauled the `AiAssistScreen` UI with colored message bubbles, typing indicators, and suggestion chips. - **Architecture & Data Persistence**: - Incremented database version to 12 and added `TypeConverters` for `List<String>` to support badge storage. - Removed all deprecated `expensetracker` legacy components, including DAOs, entities, and ViewModels. - Consolidated `ViewModelFactory` to handle the new `String`-based user identifiers. - **UI/UX & Branding**: - Established `IVUTheme` and applied it across all Compose screens for visual consistency. - Refactored XML layouts (`activity_ivu.xml`, `layout_bottom_nav.xml`) to use theme-aware color attributes. - Updated the splash screen logic to initialize demo data and user stats for new Firebase users. - **Configuration & CI**: - Updated GitHub Actions workflow to use latest `actions/checkout@v4` and `setup-java@v4`. - Set `AchievementsActivity` to `exported="true"` in `AndroidManifest.xml`.

Implement unified UI components, dark theme support, and enhanced deck management
- **Navigation & UI Architecture**: - Replaced legacy XML bottom navigation with a shared Compose `BottomNavigationBar` across `IVU`, `DecksActivity`, `JournalActivity`, `AchievementsActivity`, and `SettingsActivity`. - Integrated `Scaffold` into several screens to manage layout, bars, and floating action buttons consistently. - Updated `IVUTheme` to include specific light/dark surface and text color definitions. - **Theme & Language Management**: - Integrated `PreferenceManager` across all activities to observe and apply dark theme and app language settings dynamically. - Added a language selection dialog and a study reminders toggle in the `SettingsScreen`. - Implemented `AppCompatDelegate` observers in the main activity to handle configuration changes for theme and locale. - **Feature Enhancements**: - **Decks**: Added the ability to delete decks from both the `DecksScreen` and `FlashcardListScreen` via a confirmation dialog and dropdown menu. - **Journal**: - Implemented deck-linking for journal entries, allowing users to associate specific study decks with their entries via a new `FilterChip` UI. - Refactored `JournalViewModel` to fetch both journal and deck data. - Improved date parsing and formatting for journal entry display. - **Achievements**: Refactored the `AchievementScreen` to use Material 3 components and standardized XP progress calculation. - **Data & Configuration**: - Transitioned `FlashcardRepository` and `JournalRepository` to use `firebase_uid` instead of local IDs for user identification. - Updated `ViewModelFactory` with a cleaner `when` structure to handle multi-repository dependency injection. - Updated `strings.xml` and localized variants (Afrikaans, isiZulu) with new navigation labels, goal formats, and plural definitions. - Added a `study_reminders` key to `PreferenceManager`.

Refactor UI for localization and improve layout responsiveness
- **Localization & Internationalization**: - Externalized hardcoded strings across all screens, including Achievements, AI Assist, Decks, Journal, and Settings. - Updated `strings.xml` with new keys and placeholders for dynamic content. - Provided comprehensive Afrikaans (`values-af`) and isiZulu (`values-zu`) translations for the entire application. - **UI/UX Refinement**: - **Achievements**: Refactored `AchievementScreen` to use `LazyColumn` instead of a grid for the primary layout, improving scroll performance and layout flexibility. - **Main Dashboard**: Wrapped the main activity layout in a `ScrollView` to prevent clipping on smaller screens. - **Auth Screens**: Enhanced `LoginScreen` and `RegisterScreen` with improved typography, bold labels, and consistent field styling; removed the placeholder "Forgot Password" link. - **Journal**: Added localized mood names and improved the "New Entry" screen with better text styling and dynamic date formatting. - **Settings**: Simplified the settings menu by removing the unused Security section and externalizing status labels (e.g., "Dark", "Warm", "On/Off"). - **Feature Enhancements**: - **Progress Tracking**: Implemented logic in `IVU.kt` to reset daily review progress in the UI when a new day is detected based on `lastActiveDate`. - **AI Assist**: Added localized suggestion chips and typing indicators. - **Technical Improvements**: - Added debug logging to `ViewModelFactory` to track ViewModel instantiation. - Standardized string formatting for streaks and level labels using `%1$d` placeholders.
